name: Share the empty font features

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: Window::text_style() starts from TextStyle::default() for every call and a text element makes it twice a frame (layout, paint). FontFeatures::default() is Arc::new(Vec::new()), so each call allocates. A malloc profile of hover-grid put the largest share of main-thread malloc samples (17 of 90) under TextStyle::default.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Make FontFeatures::default a handle to one empty list per thread. Test that defaults share the list. Alternate the previous and new binaries three times on hover-grid and text-relabel, five on scroll-div-cards.

measurements.metric: scroll-div-cards allocations per frame / CPU / draw p50

reportMarkdown: A clear drop in allocations on text-heavy scenes, CPU within noise (-1% on two, +1% on div-cards, which the allocation count does not explain). The new test, the gpux lib font_features test, clippy and fmt pass.
decisionMarkdown: Keep: fewer allocations on every text element, no measurable cost.
